# Curation API

5 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/availability`

Explain whether a package version is available

Evaluates the holds that apply to one package version of a repository and lists the ones that do. A proxy repository reports its blocked flag, its curation rules and its minimum age; the publish time comes from the metadata already cached, never from the upstream, so `min_age` is `unknown` when the repository has a minimum age but the version cannot be dated. A hosted repository reports its blocked flag and the quarantine and license-policy holds of the stored version (only for formats stored in the generic package tables; scan results are matched through the version's files). A group repository has no verdict of its own, because it serves what its members serve: ask a member (400). Package and version are matched the way the format names them, see the Package curation section of the repository docs. Needs read access to the repository.

**Security:** `bearerAuth` or `cookieAuth` or .

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `package` | query | string | yes | Package name, at most 1024 bytes. |
| `version` | query | string | yes | Version string as clients see it, at most 1024 bytes. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The verdict | `application/json`: [AvailabilityResponse](schemas.md#availabilityresponse) |
| `400` | Missing or oversized `package` or `version`, or the repository is a group (`validation_failed`) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | No read access to the repository | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `404` | Repository not found | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/curation-rules`

List curation rules

The curation rules of a proxy repository in creation order. Requires global admin, or the maintainer or owner role in the repository's project. The rules only take effect while the repository's `curation_mode` is `denylist` or `allowlist`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The rules | `application/json`: [CurationRules](schemas.md#curationrules) |
| `400` | The repository is not a proxy repository (`validation_failed`) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Forbidden | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `404` | Repository not found | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/curation-rules`

Create curation rule

Add a block or allow rule to a proxy repository. A repository holds at most 1000 rules. Audited as `curation.rule_created`. Requires global admin, or the maintainer or owner role in the repository's project.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes | One of: `block`, `allow`. |
| `package_pattern` | string | yes | Maximum length: 255. |
| `reason` | string | no | Maximum length: 500. |
| `version_pattern` | string | no | Empty or absent matches every version. Maximum length: 128. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Rule created | `application/json`: [CurationRule](schemas.md#curationrule) |
| `400` | Invalid rule, or the repository is not a proxy repository (`validation_failed`) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Forbidden | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `404` | Repository not found | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `409` | The repository already holds the maximum number of rules (`conflict`) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `PATCH /api/v1/repositories/{name}/curation-rules/{id}`

Update curation rule

Change any of the rule's action, patterns and reason; absent fields keep their value. The rule must belong to the repository in the path. Audited as `curation.rule_updated`. Requires global admin, or the maintainer or owner role in the repository's project.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | no | One of: `block`, `allow`. |
| `package_pattern` | string | no | Maximum length: 255. |
| `reason` | string | no | Maximum length: 500. |
| `version_pattern` | string | no | Maximum length: 128. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Rule updated | `application/json`: [CurationRule](schemas.md#curationrule) |
| `400` | Invalid rule, or the repository is not a proxy repository (`validation_failed`) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Forbidden | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `404` | Repository or rule not found (also a rule of another repository, or an id that is not a UUID) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `DELETE /api/v1/repositories/{name}/curation-rules/{id}`

Delete curation rule

Remove a rule. The rule must belong to the repository in the path. Audited as `curation.rule_deleted`. Requires global admin, or the maintainer or owner role in the repository's project.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Rule deleted | - |
| `400` | The repository is not a proxy repository (`validation_failed`) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `403` | Forbidden | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `404` | Repository or rule not found (also a rule of another repository, or an id that is not a UUID) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
